reason: Phase 1 calibration FAILED its pre-registered acceptance (row R3: real 50 ms deletion kept 0/10, >= 8/10 required). As built, the evaluator cannot produce a KEEP for any candidate that reaches the soak (G2 new_file on the per-session /tmp/dbus-<random> socket), and LORD++ alpha falls below the bootstrap p floor after two non-rejections. Proposer candidates were therefore not submitted: every verdict would have been REVERT/REJECT by construction, and each G5 test would spend LORD++ wealth.
